'''Isis''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gutretee (species)|Gutretee]], it was a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and later became one of the [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining Worlds]] under the control of the [[Figg conglomerate]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Description==
Isis was a crystalline world that was often considered unreachable. Hidden in the fringes of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]], it could only be reached from [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] via the [[Ione–Isis hyperroute]], a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that passed by the [[Mining Worlds/Legends|Mining World]] of [[Burnin Konn/Legends|Burnin Konn]].<ref name="TEA" />

Isis' surface was covered with large translucent crystalline mountains and spires. The crystals refracted the incoming sunlight and filled the skies with countless rainbows. The canyons had an average width of 750[[Meter/Legends|m]] and a height of 12,500m. The crystal were rich in minerals and ores, but also disrupted all communications and sensors, even from orbit. Despite its unusual environment, the planet was hospitable to most sentient life.<ref name="TIC" />

==History==
Owing to its location in the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]],<ref name="wizards" /> the planet remained unknown to the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] for a long time. During the [[Rise of the Empire era|last years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], it was discovered and explored by an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Scout/Legends|scouting expedition]]. Then-[[First Chairman/Legends|First Chairman]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] foresaw the need for a hidden base in an eventual [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] uprising and kept the information about Isis to himself.<ref name="TIC" />

As the Civil War escalated, Isis became home to those who opposed the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], secreted away by Bail Organa. The colonists founded the city of [[Neskroff/Legends|Neskroff]], the planet's only spaceport, located in a giant crystal mesa. Later [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] joined the colonists as well and the Human population soon reached over 100,000 people. The planet's natural resources were [[Mining/Legends|mined]], refined and processed and manufactured into starfighters, making about 30% of the Rebel Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] production capability.<ref name="TIC" /> In contrast to other safe worlds,<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> the Isis colony enjoyed a relative high level of technology, even having a starport and with several [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-worthy [[spaceships]],<ref name="TIC" /> including several [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]<ref name="RASB" /> of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]]. The [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Handree]]'' was also based on the planet. However, due to the crystal's disrupting nature, all communication had to be transmitted via [[fiber-optic]]s.<ref name="TIC" />

The native Gutretee were mostly befriended by the colonists and learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]]. Several tribes became sympathetic to the Rebel cause and helped them mining and building, but they were forbidden to ever leave the planet.There were also tribes that remained outright hostile to the Rebels.<ref name="TIC" />

The coordinates of Isis were a close-guarded secret of the Alliance, although rumors circulated among the Imperials about the base. The Imperial [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' [[Battle of Isis|almost discovered the planet]] during the height of the civil war, but was intercepted by Rebel agents in time.<ref name="TIC" /> The system itself did not appear on any maps until the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="wizards" />

The Rebels abandoned the planet soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Isis later came under the control of the mining interests of the [[Figg conglomerate]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
===Gutretees===
{{Main|Gutretee (species)}}
[[File:Gutretee.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Gutretee.]]
The Gutretees were a crystalline, mineral-based mono-gendered species. They lived in primitive, nomadic tribal societies and had the ability to interact with the natural crystals of the planet. Their unique physiology allowed them to copy and absorb each other memories, similar to data-files.<ref name="TIC" />

===Humans===
{{Main|Human/Legends}}
Most of the Humans on Isis were political criminals or similar refugees who had fled here with the aid of Bail Organa during the ascension of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. With the continuing Civil War, more Humans from other societies joined the colony.
